DECLARATION u4h THIS DECLARATION is made as of the 'day of Mo Ve m ber ,2003(the "Declaration") by HS Development Partners LLC, having an office at c/o Time Equities Inc., 55 Fifth Avenue,NewYork,NY 10003("Declarant"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Declarant is the fee owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 170, Lot 1 and is more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (which property, together with any improvements thereon, is referred to herein as the "Subject Property"); and WHEREAS, pursuant to an Agreement dated [M0V&m ber /4] , 2003, with the New York State Urban Development Corporation d/b/a Empire State Development Corporation ("ESDC")(the "Agreement"); Declarant has agreed to restrict the manner in which the Subject Propertymay be developed and used. NOW, THEREFORE, Declarant does hereby declare and agree that the Subject Property shall be held, transferred, conveyed and occupied subject to the following restrictions, covenants, obligations, easements and agreements which are for the purpose of protecting the value and desirability of the Subject Property and which shall run with the land and be binding upon and inure to the benefit of every party having any right, title or interest in the Subject Property or any part thereof, and their respective successors, heirs and assigns and legal representatives: 1． Declarant covenants that the Subject Property shall be developed and used in accordance with the use and design guidelines established by ESDC set forth in Schedule B, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, as set forth fully herein (the "Design Guidelines"). 2.  Declarant covenants that a copy of this Declaration shall be submitted with any applicationforanewdevelopmentor anenlargement of anexistingbuildingat theSubject Property which is filed with the New York City Department of Buildings. 3. This Declaration, including, but not limited to all exhibits attached hereto and the Design Guidelines, may be amended, modified or cancelled by ESDC, acting through the Office of the Chairman, only upon application by Declarant. No other approval or consent by any other public body or privateparty shall be required for such amendment,modification orcancellation. 4. interested parties to this Declaration and consents to the enforcement by ESDC and/or the City, administratively or at law or at equity, of the covenants, conditions, restrictions and agreements contained herein. No other person, entity, body or agency shall have the authority to enforce the provisions of this Declaration. Doc#30634659.WPD March 31, 2003 (12:12pm) -2-
